fields.summary_ko.0: SK hynix (SKHY) stock rose 3.8% in early trading on strong Nvidia earnings, recovering from its 52-week low of $117.40.
fields.summary_ko.1: Nvidia increased memory supply commitments from $27.9 billion to $39 billion, primarily due to multi-year memory supply contracts, suggesting robust HBM demand.
fields.summary_ko.2: High-bandwidth memory is SK hynix's strategically important product and most profitable category, directly benefiting as a major Nvidia HBM supplier from AI infrastructure expansion.
